name: Original F09
idea: Reference: the exact F09 geometry, at 18 degrees.

name: Gentle lean
idea: 12 degrees; original shape and stroke weight.

name: Lively lean
idea: 24 degrees; original shape and stroke weight.

name: Bold lean
idea: 30 degrees; original shape and stroke weight.

name: Long tines
idea: Tines extend upward by 5 units; original bowl and handle.

name: Short tines
idea: Tines start 6 units lower; original bowl and handle.

name: Narrow fork
idea: Tines and bowl are 8 units narrower; same height.

name: Broad fork
idea: Tines and bowl are 8 units wider; same height.

name: Shallow bowl
idea: A flatter bowl; the handle starts at its new center.

name: Deep bowl
idea: A deeper curved root, with the same overall height.

name: Soft square
idea: A short flat bottom with rounded shoulders.

name: Rounded V
idea: Slanted shoulders converge at a gently rounded root.
